claude_proposed_widenings.name: triggered passive weapon rider family for magic items
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Sword of Sharpness is not an always-on passive grant and not an activated ability. Its mechanics are conditional weapon-hit and critical-hit riders attached to wielding the item. Current MagicItemMechanics only allows passive or activation, so any encoding would misstate timing or action economy.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you attack an object with this magic weapon and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, that target takes an extra 14 Slashing damage and gains 1 Exhaustion level.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: trigger variant for natural-20 weapon attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The creature rider keys off a natural 20 on the d20, not merely a hit. Existing on-hit trigger shapes only express weapon_hit or melee-only weapon_hit, so they cannot distinguish this stricter trigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll

claude_proposed_widenings.name: maximize_weapon_damage_dice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The object rider replaces the rolled weapon damage dice result with its maximum value. Existing atoms can add damage or modify d20 rolls, but they cannot maximize an already-resolving weapon damage roll.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: maximize your weapon damage dice against the target

claude_proposed_widenings.name: increment leveled exhaustion by 1
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: apply_condition with condition=exhaustion only captures presence of the condition, not gaining one additional exhaustion level. Sword of Sharpness needs an incremental leveled-condition effect.
